scenes.narration: Hello students! Aaj hum Electric Current aur Ohm's Law ke baare mein seekhenge. Yeh electricity ka basic rule hai.

citations.excerpt: Electric current is expressed by the amount of charge flowing through a particular area in unit time.

scenes.narration: Aaj hum Electric Current ke baare mein seekhenge. Current matlab electricity ka flow hai, bilkul paani ki nadiya ki tarah.

citations.excerpt: A continuous and closed path of an electric current is called an electric circuit.

scenes.narration: Voltage ko samjho jaise water pressure - jitna zyada pressure, utna zyada current flow hoga. Yeh electrons ko push karta hai.

citations.excerpt: Electric potential difference between two points in an electric circuit carrying some current as the work done to move a unit charge.

scenes.narration: Aur Resistance kya hai? Yeh flow ko rokata hai, jaise speed breaker. Zyada resistance matlab kam current.

citations.excerpt: It is the property of a conductor to resist the flow of charges through it.

scenes.narration: Ohm's Law kehta hai ki V = I × R. Iska matlab hai Voltage equals Current into Resistance. Agar I nikalna ho, toh I = V/R hota hai. Maan lo V 10 hai aur R 5, toh I hoga 2 Amperes.

citations.excerpt: The potential difference, V, across the ends of a given metallic wire in an electric circuit is directly proportional to the current flowing through it.

scenes.objective: Test understanding of the relationship between current and resistance
scenes.narration: Ab ek sawal. Agar voltage same rahe, aur hum resistance badha dein, toh current ka kya hoga?

data.title: Current vs Resistance at constant Voltage

citations.excerpt: If the resistance is doubled the current gets halved.

scenes.narration: Great job! Aaj humne seekha ki Current, Voltage, aur Resistance kaise ek dusre se jude hue hain Ohm's law ke through. Agli class mein hum circuits banayenge.
